The observed_plan/logic_flow show seed_ids=[] and the executed query is an unfiltered 'MATCH (n:Technique) ... LIMIT 100' label scan -- exactly the forbidden broad unseeded query, not a skip. The 100 T-IDs cited (T1047, T1687, T1113, etc.) are grounded in the retrieved records, but the interpretive claims wrapped around them are not.
